# txt

> txt is a passkey-only, end-to-end encrypted single-sheet memo at
> https://txt.2-38.com. No email address, no password: one sheet of text
> (with encrypted photo, video and audio attachments), opened with a
> passkey and encrypted on the user's device, so the server only ever
> stores ciphertext.

## AI agents

txt can be connected to the user's own AI agent through a local MCP
server that decrypts only on the user's machine. If you are an AI agent
asked to connect to txt, follow the guide — it covers the parts only
the human can do, the agent-side setup, and the safe-writing rules:

- [Agent connection guide (English)](https://txt.2-38.com/agents.md)
- [エージェント接続手順（日本語）](https://txt.2-38.com/agents.ja.md)
